newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN SUGAR FIRM ON FESTIVAL BUYING.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN SUGAR FIRM ON FESTIVAL BUYING.

text.p: Sugar prices turned firm on local Indian markets as consumers bought ahead of upcoming festivals, dealers said.
In ready delivery sugar S-30 rose 20 rupees to 1,490/1,520 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 rose five rupees to 1,515/1,550.

"The state governments have increased supplies of sugar through the public distribution system for coming festivals but the poor quality in the system has led to higher offtake of sugar in the open market," said Shantilal Dedhiya, secretary to Bombay Sugar Merchant's Association.
Sugar for mill delivery was subdued amid lower than expected outstation buying which prompted offerings by the millers.
In the mill delivery, sugar S-30 slid five rupees to 1,420/1,430 rupees per quintal while sugar M-30 fell by five rupees to 1,435/1,450.
